chapter: Home life and the father's death
title: Lorenzo's children and grandchildren in New Rochelle
summary: Lorenzo's family live in New Rochelle; a daughter plays flute in a New York symphony and a grandson is taking up clarinet.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Yeah, they're living in New Rochelle, New York. Up in New Rochelle. They rented their home out in Mount Vernon and then they moved to, that's the suburb like you know.
Yes, this is the next town. I used to live up that way myself.
Yeah, well you know what it's all about. And there she got this home and she's got a daughter and also that played the flute.
And she played in one of these symphons in New York. She's in school, she goes to college I think over there and she played in one of them symphony orchestras there.
Did any of your family play the flute that is your uncle or father?
